Q1_minimum_for_VERSION_RECOMMENDATION.answer: L1 (L0 + scanner reference graph). Scanner FixedVersion alone (L0) yields candidates only (PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED). Advisory confirmation via S001/S002/S004-S007 at L1 makes C2 SUPPORTED. L2 adds independent corroboration but is not the minimum.

Q4_minimum_for_EXECUTABLE_PATCH_PLAN.answer: L3 for source-complete draftability + L4/L5 for safe command emission. L3 removes the artifact block; L4 supplies compatibility reasoning; L5 supplies runtime deploy/validation procedure. Production must gate command/validation_command on L3+L4+L5 jointly (with per-action exceptions for pure donor cases reviewed by human).

Q5_is_L3_sufficient_for_three_blockers.answer: Yes for source/artifact/integrity reachability: ognl:ognl:3.0.21, xstream:1.4.10, freemarker:2.3.23 all POM+JAR+SHA1 reachable with SHA-1 match. No for automatic validator readiness: commands still undrafted/unreviewed.

Q6_is_L3_alone_enough_for_safe_commands.answer: No. L3 gives what to install; L4 gives whether the version jump is compatible (2.3.34 vs 2.5.10.1, REST notes); L5 gives how to install it in this runtime (Tomcat WAR/exploded/backup/redeploy). UZBL5's 5 ready commands relied on partial-L5 Tomcat docs (S014-S017) plus donor locality, proving procedure evidence matters.

Q7_deterministic_vs_LLM.answer: Deterministic: package/PURL normalization, advisory queries (NVD/OSV/GHSA/KEV), native-registry metadata/POM/artifact/checksum retrieval, redirect-chain recording, domain classification, source-graph build + validation, checksum hashing, confidence-rule evaluation, policy rejection. LLM-assisted (downstream only): advisory/release-note interpretation, upgrade/closure tradeoff reasoning, procedure drafting from retrieved evidence, abstention explanation, human-review notes. LLM must never create roots, invent domains, or promote authority.

Q8_mandatory_before_command_suggestion.answer: L3 (provenance+integrity+closure for every artifact in the closure) AND L4 (compatibility/release-note basis for the selected version) AND L5 (runtime-vendor deploy/validation procedure for the target runtime) must all be present before LLM Patch Assist may suggest command/validation_command. Narrow exception: pure local-donor replacement with byte-equality + runtime procedure evidence + human review may proceed without remote registry, but must still cite L5-equivalent deploy docs.

Q9_fields_UNKNOWN_unless_L4_L5.answer: compatibility_notes, migration_notes, major/minor-upgrade rationale, module-alignment rationale (L4); deploy_steps, redeploy_behavior, backup/preserve procedure, WAR-vs-exploded handling, service-stop/start expectations, validation smoke criteria beyond hash checks (L5). command and validation_command remain null unless L3+L4+L5 jointly satisfied.
Q9_fields_UNKNOWN_unless_L4_L5.uzbl5_anchor: proposed_patch_form notes fields; decision_log Q5 assumptions

Q10_insufficient_evidence_behavior.answer: Abstain on the blocked fields (null + typed reason code), file a partial proposal for the supported actions, request human input via WAITING_FOR_USER_INPUT + missing_evidence record, and mark every unsupported field UNKNOWN/INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. Never emit guessed commands, guessed versions, or guessed checksums. Preserve candidate-only sources as rejected/candidate rather than silently dropping them.
